Convert "ts-boxable" objects to xts format (extension of tsbox::ts_xts())

conv_xts.Rd

Convert "ts-boxable" objects to xts format (extension of tsbox::ts_xts())

Usage

conv_xts(x)

Arguments

x

a "ts-boxable" object to be converted

Value

returns an object in xts format.

Details

This function performs a similar operation to tsbox::ts_xts(). It converts ts-boxable objects to the xts format. An important difference compared with tsbox::ts_xts() is that the x argument of conv_xts() can be a wide tbl.

Examples

quarterly_data_example |>
  conv_tslist() |>
  conv_xts() |>
  tsbox::ts_pick(1:3) |>
  tail(3)
#>             E_NF_HI   ECT_HI   EMN_HI
#> 2024-07-01 639.7316 39.56811 12.83472
#> 2024-10-01 643.2565 39.11035 12.97680
#> 2025-01-01 647.9022 39.39811 13.16324
quarterly_data_example |>
  conv_wide() |>
  conv_xts() |>
  tsbox::ts_pick(1:3) |>
  tail(3)
#>             E_NF_HI   ECT_HI   EMN_HI
#> 2024-07-01 639.7316 39.56811 12.83472
#> 2024-10-01 643.2565 39.11035 12.97680
#> 2025-01-01 647.9022 39.39811 13.16324
quarterly_data_example |>
  tsbox::ts_long() |>
  tsbox::ts_pick("E_NF_HI") |>
  conv_wide() |>
  conv_xts()
#>             E_NF_HI
#> 1998-01-01 530.5066
#> 1998-04-01 531.2062
#> 1998-07-01 532.6954
#> 1998-10-01 531.4825
#> 1999-01-01 529.5065
#> 1999-04-01 533.2071
#> 1999-07-01 537.3354
#> 1999-10-01 541.2599
#> 2000-01-01 544.4418
#> 2000-04-01 551.0984
#>        ...         
#> 2022-10-01 627.5995
#> 2023-01-01 631.2647
#> 2023-04-01 633.7569
#> 2023-07-01 632.2179
#> 2023-10-01 631.8120
#> 2024-01-01 636.9010
#> 2024-04-01 636.4715
#> 2024-07-01 639.7316
#> 2024-10-01 643.2565
#> 2025-01-01 647.9022
